## Where I am

Drag-and-resize dashboards are implemented on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2` (PR #418, draft). Widgets persist via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` with a localStorage fallback. Container queries were dropped for ResizeObserver sizing, which works on iOS 15. Storybook builds again, the rename and lint are done, and v1 dashboards stay untouched behind the `dashboards_v2` flag. Remaining: Priya's UX review on iPad, then enabling the flag for the Zest workspace before the demo on Tuesday 24th.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 awaiting Priya's UX review on iPad (Safari, iOS 15)
- [prochaine-étape] Priya reviews the UX and the iPad behaviour
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only, in the flags admin (no code change)
- [prochaine-étape] Zest demo on Tuesday 24th
- [essai-raté] Container queries: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules silently, so they were removed in favour of ResizeObserver (`useWidgetSize`, `data-size`)
- [décision] Drop container queries and use a single ResizeObserver sizing system (source: t09)
- [décision] Keep v1 dashboards available behind the flag until January; nothing is removed now (source: t15)
